howto_1: ROLL all your dice. Pick 3-5 of them in order: matching elements form a combo (Trio, Duo Pact, Full Moon, Quartet...). REROLL the picked dice twice per battle.
howto_2: SUMMON scores the squad: combo base, then each scored die's points left to right, then trinkets. Strength = Power × Count. 3 summons per battle.
howto_3: The army's total hits the hunter. Beat its HP and the battle ends at once; unused summons pay $1 each. BONE faces are always 6.
howto_4: In the Crypt Market buy trinkets, potions (rewrite faces, add runes), gems (level combos), new dice and gear. Survive 8 nights.
tut_first_roll: ROLL your dice, pick 3-5 that form a combo (3 of an element, 2+2, a ritual...), then SUMMON.
tut_first_shop: Trinkets trigger left to right. Drag to reorder. Dice are the strongest upgrade.
tut_first_summon: Squad strength = Power × Count. When the army beats the hunter's HP the battle ends.
